shots.detail_en: Before the opening bell falls, MANCANG watches the Lianhua Tech flip-board plunge from height straight underwater — red to green in three flips.
shots.speaker: 散户甲
shots.fx: 翻牌三连重响·人声骤起

shots.detail_en: The old hall explodes; the retail legion tumbles over itself, MANCANG among them; RETAIL B clutches the Lianhua Wins little flag, its pole propped on the floor.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: The order window is a receding dike — MANCANG's slip is pushed back again and again, his floral shirt squeezed by the tide of people.
shots.sub: 让让！我的单——还没出去啊！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Board-green light washes MANCANG's face; staring at his own line of numbers, he sinks lower as the shouting peels away layer by layer.
MANCANG kneels on the bench, the sob leaking out inch by inch — the first liquidation of his life.
shots.speaker: 满仓
shots.fx: 喜感鼓点全灭·只剩抽泣

shots.detail_en: At the counter RED stamps the slip with her head bowed, voice gone soft; an iron box opens and MANCANG's pager is placed inside.
shots.sub: 欠单未清——通讯工具，先押在柜台。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The retail legion rises and leaves one by one; armbands and the little flag stay on the bench like boats stranded by the ebb, MANCANG watching them go.
The lights go off row by row; the empty hall keeps only MANCANG, knees hugged on the bench.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Rainy night: CH umbrellas up to the old cha chaan teng and hauls MANCANG off the steps inside — the floral shirt soaked through, pasted to his back.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Steam swirls in the cha chaan teng; CH tosses a towel over MANCANG's head.
shots.speaker: 满仓
shots.fx: 毛巾闷响·市井电台杂音

shots.detail_en: Two soda bottles habitually set on the table; CH looks at them for two seconds, returns one to the icebox, leaving a single bottle.
shots.sub: 仓没了……汽水，也得省一瓶。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH opens the bottle and pushes the fizzing soda in front of MANCANG, bubbles climbing in strings.
shots.sub: 仓没了，人还在。人还在——就还有下一单。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG stares at the bubbles at the bottle mouth; tears hit the tabletop.
shots.sub: 全没了……气泡还一个劲地冒。
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH watches the rain curtain; the water streaks on the glass look like falling K-lines.
shots.sub: 仓位是船，命不是。船沉了能再造——人沉了，就真的沉了。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: In the VIP box the prayer beads turn at an even pace; XIONG gazes down at the emptied hall.
shots.sub: 有人替所有人交了学费。学费越疼——记得越牢。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Server room: green dots fall like rain, data flowing across XIONGWEI's rimless lenses.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH's home at midnight: he links the points where he was struck these three days, the page turning into a spiderweb.
shots.sub: 连输三天。我总得知道——它先到的那半步，藏在哪里。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: The linked lines reveal the tail of a pattern: every counter-strike came half a beat early — like someone stepping to his heartbeat.
shots.sub: 不是快——是它知道，我什么时候出手。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: The pen stops; CH writes one slow line onto the page.
shots.sub: 机器没有心跳——但它有电流。
shots.speaker: 旁白
shots.fx: 笔尖一顿·电流音混入滴答

shots.detail_en: The pocket watch lies by the page; the tick and the electric hum lock into one shared beat.
shots.sub: 电流有频率，频率有节拍——有节拍，就有缝。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Dawn, rain unbroken: on the exchange's back-door steps MANCANG kneels in the water looking up; CH reaches his hand out — raindrops strike the back of his hand; freeze frame.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Black end-card with white caption text.
